scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n back,front -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start: npx concurrently -n back,front -c blue,green "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.bootstrap: npm run install:all && npm run dev
